ai_summary: Canara Bank has announced an earnings and conference call scheduled for October 14, 2026, to discuss its standalone and consolidated financial results for the second quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026, with analysts and investors. This routine regulatory disclosure provides virtual meeting details, including the participation of senior management, and does not contain financial data or indicate any immediate red flags. The material impacts of the bank's performance will be disclosed and discussed during the actual conference call.
